# Isaiah Chapter 38 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 22 verses]*

*Fifteen years added; sundial sign; Hezekiah's psalm of thanksgiving; life from the pit*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 38 (Hezekiah's Illness) addresses fifteen years added; sundial sign; hezekiah's psalm of thanksgiving; life from the pit. The key verse — "I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
